name: smwpatches-sprite-item-box
title: Sprite Item Box
description:
This patch will draw the item box (and optionally the item) using sprite tiles. Useful if you want to get rid of the layer 3 status bar, but still need the item box to work. Check out the readme and asm file for more info (especially if you're using the "Remove Status Bar" patch!).
Requested by Anas.
